# Homa

> The calm homeschool assistant that shows you it's working.

URL: https://thankshoma.com

## What Homa Does

Homa is an AI homeschool assistant for parents of children ages 2 to 16. It learns each child, generates personalized printable materials, tracks hours for your state, and shows you it's working through progress reports mapped to your state's standards.

## Who It's For

Homeschool parents who want less admin and more teaching. Parents who use their own curriculum, co-ops, or a mix of bought, borrowed, and homemade materials.

## Key Features

- Free developmental progress report (takes five minutes)
- Personalized printable worksheets and materials
- State standards mapping with coverage at a glance
- Hour tracking for state compliance
- AI assistant that plans around your curriculum
- Works for ages 2 to 16, with questionnaires tuned to each age

## Try It

Get a free progress report showing exactly where your child stands: https://thankshoma.com/onboarding

## Important

- Homa is for parents only. Your child never sees the questionnaire and never talks to an AI.
- The progress report is free. Homa itself is free while the first families shape it.
